svg.text: DECELERATION LANE → (40 m taper + 46 m parallel, indicative)
CENTRAL RESERVE WITH SAFETY BARRIER — NO MEDIAN CROSSING AT SITE
M4 INTERSTATE HIGHWAY (Yerevan – Sevan) — generic 2×2 divided cross-section, 90 km/h
LONG-VEHICLE BAY 18 × 3.2 m (minibus / camper / coach drop-off)
QUEUE: 13 CARS FROM PICKUP WINDOW TO SITE ENTRY (6.0 m per car) — no overspill onto the M4
Planting — native steppe grasses, apricot trees
Highway drive-thru prototype — concept design (RIBA Stage 2)
Scale 1:200 @ A1 · dimensions in metres unless noted
Site geometry is a generic M4 roadside parcel; adapt to
topographic survey, title plan and Roads Dept. junction approval.
1. Counter-clockwise circulation keeps the building on the driver's left
2. Dual order lanes with tablet order-takers ('runners') at peak; digital menu
boards + speakers OP-A/OP-B as back-up. Lanes merge before W1 (payment / order
3. 13-car stack from pickup to entry; a further 4 cars can queue on the decel
lane only in exceptional peaks — operating rule: open walk-in counter / extra
4. Separate bypass aisle lets parking customers avoid the drive-thru queue.
Long-vehicle bay keeps coaches out of the lanes.
5. Target service time ≤ 3:30 min order-to-hand-off; peak throughput 90–110
